shortDescription: Manage registration and subscriptions to RHSM using C(subscription-manager)

options.name: activationkey
options.description: Supply an activation key for use with registration.

options.name: auto_attach
options.description: Upon successful registration, auto-consume available subscriptions. Please note that the alias O(ignore:autosubscribe) was removed in community.general 9.0.0.

options.name: consumer_id
options.description: References an existing consumer ID to resume using a previous registration for this system. If the system's identity certificate is lost or corrupted, this option allows it to resume using its previous identity and subscriptions. The default is to not specify a consumer ID so a new ID is created.

options.name: consumer_name
options.description: Name of the system to register, defaults to the hostname.

options.name: consumer_type
options.description: The type of unit to register, defaults to system.

options.name: environment
options.description: Register with a specific environment in the destination org. Used with Red Hat Satellite or Katello.

options.name: force_register
options.description: Register the system even if it is already registered.

options.name: org_id
options.description: Organization ID to use in conjunction with activationkey.

options.name: password
options.description: Access.redhat.com or Red Hat Satellite or Katello password.

options.name: pool_ids
options.description: Specify subscription pool IDs to consume. A pool ID may be specified as a C(string) - just the pool ID (for example V(0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef)), or as a C(dict) with the pool ID as the key, and a quantity as the value (for example V(0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef: 2). If the quantity is provided, it is used to consume multiple entitlements from a pool (the pool must support this).

options.name: release
options.description: Set a release version.

options.name: rhsm_baseurl
options.description: Specify CDN baseurl.

options.name: rhsm_repo_ca_cert
options.description: Specify an alternative location for a CA certificate for CDN.

options.name: server_hostname
options.description: Specify an alternative Red Hat Subscription Management or Red Hat Satellite or Katello server.

options.name: server_insecure
options.description: Enable or disable https server certificate verification when connecting to O(server_hostname).

options.name: server_port
options.description: Specify the port when registering to the Red Hat Subscription Management or Red Hat Satellite or Katello server.

options.name: server_prefix
options.description: Specify the prefix when registering to the Red Hat Subscription Management or Red Hat Satellite or Katello server.

options.name: server_proxy_hostname
options.description: Specify an HTTP proxy hostname.

options.name: server_proxy_password
options.description: Specify a password for HTTP proxy with basic authentication.

options.name: server_proxy_port
options.description: Specify an HTTP proxy port.

options.name: server_proxy_scheme
options.description: Specify an HTTP proxy scheme, for example V(http) or V(https).

options.name: server_proxy_user
options.description: Specify a user for HTTP proxy with basic authentication.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to register and subscribe (V(present)), or unregister (V(absent)) a system.

options.name: syspurpose
options.description: Set syspurpose attributes in file C(/etc/rhsm/syspurpose/syspurpose.json) and synchronize these attributes with RHSM server. Syspurpose attributes help attach the most appropriate subscriptions to the system automatically. When C(syspurpose.json) file already contains some attributes, then new attributes overwrite existing attributes. When some attribute is not listed in the new list of attributes, the existing attribute is removed from C(syspurpose.json) file. Unknown attributes are ignored.

options.name: token
options.description: Sso.redhat.com API access token.

options.name: username
options.description: Access.redhat.com or Red Hat Satellite or Katello username.
